description: Pure engine that computes the new order of rows (or columns) for a SpreadsheetSortSpec. The sort is stable across levels and follows Excel's type ordering via SpreadsheetCellValueComparer; blanks always sort last. Colour sorts pin the chosen colour to the active end.

members.name: ComputeOrder
members.description: Computes the sorted order of the primary axis. With ByRows false (default) it returns the data row indices in their new order; with it true it returns the data column indices. The header row/column, when present, is excluded from the result.
